prompts.name: dinosaur
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: downloadable game sprite for a children's Python dinosaur endless runner. Create ONE original cute mint-green baby tyrannosaurus dinosaur facing RIGHT in side view, playful chunky retro pixel art, dark navy 2-pixel-looking outline, cream belly, tiny arms, big friendly eye, orange cheek, two clearly separated running feet. Limited palette, crisp square pixel clusters, no gradients, no shadows on the ground, no text, no logos. Full body entirely visible, centered, occupies 85 percent of a square canvas, otherwise real transparent background. Consistent game art palette: mint #50b890, dark navy #24384b, cream #fff0cc, orange #f0a45a. This is a usable isolated sprite, not a presentation sheet.
